rule: **C4 Unresolved references are preserved.** A call the tool cannot resolve is still emitted as a low guess (`recv.m`, `.m`, a bare name). It is never dropped and never promoted to a resolved ID. Silence in the graph means no call, or a `coverage` note. **low**: a guess — receiver of unknown type (`recv.m`, `.m`), or a bare name not found in the scan.
notes: frobnicate and net_external_hook are dependent calls in a template body that no declaration in the scan (or anywhere) provides; C4 requires them as bare-name low guesses, never dropped and never promoted to a namespace-qualified resolved ID (not net.frobnicate). checksum(msg) is found by ordinary lookup at the template definition → net.checksum, high. 'struct Packet { int id; }' and the field access p.id are not calls.
